children.summary: Transforming observations into knowledge, knowledge into models, and models into decisions.

children.title: Platforms
children.subtitle: Applied intelligence modules
children.summary: Core platform modules for engineering, medicine, reasoning, and decision support.

children.title: Calyrai core
children.subtitle: Central reasoning engine
children.summary: Connects observations, knowledge, models, and decisions.
children.body: Calyrai core is the central reasoning engine of the ecosystem. It links observations, knowledge representation, learning workflows, surrogate models, and decision support into a unified framework.

children.title: brix
children.subtitle: Engineering intelligence
children.body: Engineering intelligence platform for structural analysis, design exploration, and decision support. Brix combines simulations, measurements, and surrogate models to enable rapid variant evaluation and uncertainty-aware engineering decisions.

children.title: aflowtex
children.subtitle: Medical flow intelligence
children.summary: Patient-specific flow modelling and clinical decision support.
children.body: Aflowtex combines clinical data, vascular modelling, flow simulation, and surrogate reasoning to support patient-specific analysis and uncertainty-aware medical decisions.

children.title: lithos
children.subtitle: Consequence intelligence
children.body: Lithos translates model outputs into actionable decisions by evaluating consequences, risks, trade-offs, and long-term system effects.

children.title: oracle
children.subtitle: Knowledge extraction engine
children.summary: Extracting knowledge from complex information spaces.
children.body: Oracle transforms biological, technical, scientific, and cultural datasets into structured knowledge graphs, reasoning paths, and machine-readable representations.

children.title: delphi
children.subtitle: Interactive oracle interface
children.body: Delphi provides an interactive interface for navigating knowledge, discovering patterns, and generating insights from oracle-generated knowledge structures.
